defect: For this file the fix only folds the screen offset into the viewport X/Y constants (a minor optimization); the actual bug fixes were in CrossSIMD.h (NEON LoadConvertS8 and Vec4U16::FromVec4S32), which this change did not touch.
reason: The DepthRaster.cpp part of the fix is mathematically equivalent to the code this change added, and the repaired CrossSIMD.h errors were not introduced by this commit.

defect: CPU_NextState and CPU_SetState change cpuThreadState and notify the condition variable without holding cpuThreadLock, so a waiter in CPU_WaitStatus can miss the wakeup (lost-wakeup race/deadlock on shutdown and run handshakes).
reason: The fix adds the missing lock_guard to exactly these new state-transition functions (plus a separate reply condvar), and the unlocked notify pattern is visible in the added code.

defect: In this header the fix only adds comments to the PdpStat/PtpStat fields and declares a new getAvailToRecv helper; the behavioural rcv_sb_cc fix lives in other files.
reason: The header changes of the fix are documentation and a new declaration, not a repair of lines this change added.

defect: LockRect is called with D3DLOCK_DISCARD for every mip level and also for D3DPOOL_MANAGED textures without D3DUSAGE_DYNAMIC, which is invalid, so the lock fails and rect.pBits is used uninitialized, crashing.
reason: The fix restricts DISCARD to level 0, always creates dynamic default-pool textures and checks the lock result, repairing the lock flags this change introduced.

defect: The new Jit_TcU8ToFloat converts u8 texcoords with UCVTF but omits the 1/128 normalization that Step_TcU8ToFloat applies, producing texcoords 128x too large.
reason: The fix adds the fixed-point scale (UCVTF ..., 7) to the function added by this change; seeing the expected scale requires the C++ step in VertexDecoderCommon.cpp.

defect: The fix corrects the address/size arithmetic of textureCache_.Invalidate in DoBlockTransfer (missing bpp factors), which this change left unchanged while only replacing the third argument true with GPU_INVALIDATE_HINT.
reason: The wrong address and size expressions existed before this change, so the repaired defect predates it.

defect: For this file the fix only comments out the INFO_LOG 'FRAMESKIP' message that this change added, to stop log spam.
reason: Removing a noisy log line is a logging/style change, not the repair of a functional defect; the real frameskip+unbuffered fix is in DisplayListInterpreter.cpp.

defect: The new split of skipDrawReason returns on SKIPDRAW_SKIPFRAME before SetRenderFrameBuffer, so during frameskip the new unbuffered logic (display-FB tracking, dirtyAfterDisplay, SKIPDRAW_NON_DISPLAYED_FB) is not updated and frameskip with unbuffered rendering breaks.
reason: The fix, 21 minutes later by the same author, moves the SKIPFRAME check after SetRenderFrameBuffer in exactly the lines this change wrote; understanding why needs Framebuffer.cpp.

defect: ToShortFriendlyPath calls path_.ToVisualString() on path_, which is a std::string, so non-UWP builds fail to compile.
reason: The fix wraps it as Path(path_).ToVisualString() in the line this change added, and the diff shows path_ used as a string.

defect: The fix changes NotifyFramebuffer to take the vfb and derive address/stride per channel, and fixes the never-cleared STATUS_FRAMEBUFFER_OVERLAP flag in TextureCacheCommon; this change only corrected fb_address to z_address for the depth notification.
reason: The repaired invalidation bug lies in TextureCacheCommon code not written by this change; the edits in this file are an interface refactor.

defect: The fix only removes a stale comment '// Need to account for sign of Y' left on the vpY0 line.
reason: A comment-only change repairs no defect.

defect: The fix capitalizes the Greek language name in GetLangValuesMapping, a display-string typo that was moved unchanged from MenuScreens.cpp.
reason: The string already had the same spelling before this change (code move), and it is a cosmetic text fix.

defect: The fix passes th instead of tw as texture height to CreateTexture; the 2D call already had this 'old typo' before the change, which merely copied it into the new GL_TEXTURE_3D call.
reason: The typo predates the change, and in the new 3D path the height only feeds canWrap, which is always true on the GL3/GLES3 devices that support 3D textures, so the change added no effective defect.

defect: The fix changes the Frame Skipping PopupMultiChoice count from 9 to 10 items; the change only moved that line, which already passed 9 for the 10-entry array.
reason: The off-by-one item count existed before the change, which relocated the line verbatim.

defect: The commit renamed ID_OPTIONS_FRAMESKIP_1/FRAMESKIP_1 to ID_OPTIONS_FRAMESKIP_AUTO/FRAMESKIP_AUTO in resource.h and WndMainWindow.h but left 'case ID_OPTIONS_FRAMESKIP_1: setFrameSkipping(FRAMESKIP_1);' in WndProc, so the Windows build no longer compiles (and it also translated a formatted message with g->T).
reason: The fix replaces the stale case with the AUTO identifiers and stops translating the formatted string; confirming the missing identifiers needs the renamed headers.

defect: The color-test equality path emits round255f(v.rgb), but round255f takes a float, so the generated GLSL fails to compile for vec3.
reason: The fix adds a vec3 round255v helper and uses it in the line this change added.

defect: Exists() dereferences cache_->HasData() although cache_ stays nullptr when the file size is 0 (InitCache is skipped), causing a null-pointer crash.
reason: The fix adds the missing cache_ null check to the line this change added, and the constructor in the same diff shows cache_ can be null.

defect: Centralizing vsync made the GPUCommon constructor call UpdateVsyncInterval(true), which compares the uninitialized new member lastVsync_ and calls gfxCtx_->SwapInterval even for GPUs without a context (headless), crashing.
reason: The fix initializes lastVsync_ to -1 in this header and guards gfxCtx_ in GPUCommon.cpp, both repairing code this commit added; the crash path is only visible in GPUCommon.cpp.

defect: When the ZIP has no PSP content, progressBar_ and doneView_ are never created, but update() still dereferences progressBar_ when the GameManager state is not IDLE, causing a null-pointer crash.
reason: The change made these views conditional and guarded only the IDLE branch; the fix adds the missing null check, which a reviewer can see in the same diff.

defect: Comp_Vmtvc maps the VFPU register with fpr.MapRegV(vs) but stores fpr.RX(vs), the FPU-register accessor, so the wrong host register is written to vfpuCtrl.
reason: The fix changes RX to VX in the function this change added, and the MapRegV/RX mismatch is visible in the diff.

defect: SetGame sleeps up to 3 seconds while g_isLoggingIn, but the HTTP login callbacks run on the same main thread, so login never progresses during the wait and achievements still fail to activate (while blocking the UI).
reason: The fix states the workaround 'didn't work at all' and replaces this sleep loop with an IsReadyToStart gate; seeing that callbacks run on the main thread needs the download-manager code.

defect: The added condition '|| entry->invalidHint == -1' re-attaches entries holding an invalid framebuffer on every exact match, making textures switch between framebuffers and causing map flickering in Tactics Ogre.
reason: The fix is an exact revert of this changed condition and fixes the flicker (the issue number predates the change, so this attribution carries some uncertainty), and the effect is not predictable from the code alone.

defect: The fix corrects wording in the usage text ('non-inactive' to 'non-interactive') and the order shown in the usage line.
reason: Help-text wording is documentation, not a functional defect.

defect: The SINGLEDELETE case writes 'if(param.Delete(param.GetPspParam()), param.GetSelectedSave())', so the comma operator discards Delete's result and the selected save is not passed to Delete.
reason: The fix moves the parenthesis in the line this change added, and the misplaced parenthesis is plainly visible in the diff.

defect: The fix renames the call js.PrefixStart() to js.PrefixUnknown() because the same fix commit redefined PrefixStart to mean 'assume default prefixes'; at this change PrefixStart already marked all prefixes unknown.
reason: The call was correct for the semantics at the time and is only adapted to an API change made by the fix itself.

defect: The new 16-to-32-bit reinterpret shader samples the left texel at v_texcoord (the boundary between two source texels) and the right one at +0.5 texel, instead of at -0.25 and +0.25 of the destination pixel, so it reads the wrong 16-bit pixels.
reason: The fix corrects the UV offsets in the lines this change added; checking them needs the meaning of texSize from the draw2D uniforms.

defect: The fix replaces GE_DSTBLEND_DOUBLESRCALPHA with GE_SRCBLEND_DOUBLESRCALPHA in NeedsTestDiscard, a type typo that existed before the change (which only moved the function) and has the same value.
reason: The typo predates the change and the fix states it has no behaviour change, only a warning fix.

defect: In code from this change the fix only makes the raw audio channel sample address clickable (passing ImControl to DrawAudioChannels); its other edits (callstack rows, PushID) touch code not written by this change.
reason: The edits to this change's lines are a feature, not the repair of a defect introduced here.

defect: The fix renames the ImClickableValue parameter from addr to value and declares a new ImClickableValueFloat helper.
reason: A parameter rename and a new declaration are refactor/feature work, not a defect repair.

defect: ChatMenu is registered as a global pointer through setChatPointer (EmuScreen) and the friend-finder thread calls ch->UpdateChat(), but ChatMenu has no destructor clearing it, so after the popup closes proAdhoc uses a dangling pointer and crashes randomly.
reason: The fix adds ~ChatMenu() calling setChatPointer(NULL) for the class this commit created; the pointer registration and its use are in EmuScreen.cpp and proAdhoc.cpp.

defect: The fix only deletes the stale trailing comment '// we just skip A.' from the SOCOM lookup line.
reason: A comment-only change repairs no defect.

defect: The new context-switch DEBUG_LOG format string ends with '%08)', an invalid conversion specifier, so formatting is undefined (garbage output or an invalid-parameter abort in MSVC CRT) and the last argument is not printed.
reason: The fix changes '%08)' to '%08x)' in the line this change added, and the malformed specifier is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix snapshots skipBufferEffects per frame and adds a framebufferBound check in the background-render path, written for the later run-behind-pause feature and setting changes while the game runs in the background.
reason: The code it changes was largely added by later commits; this change neither runs the game in the background nor contains the repaired logic.

defect: The fix moves processing of pending UI messages after g_screenManager->update(); this change only switched message identifiers from strings to an enum and kept the existing order.
reason: The event order the fix repairs existed before this change.

defect: The fix removes a duplicate table entry {0x20628E6F, 0, 'sceUmdGetErrorStatFunction'} added by the change.
reason: HLE lookup returns the first matching NID, so the later duplicate was never reached; removing it is a cleanup, not the repair of a behavioural defect.

defect: BrowseAndBoot puts the memstick PSP/GAME directory into the file-name buffer instead of passing it as the dialog's initial folder (and without a trailing separator), so 'open from memstick' does not open the dialog in that folder.
reason: The fix passes defaultPath as the initial-folder argument and appends the separator, repairing lines this change added; the parameter roles are defined in W32Util::BrowseForFileName.

defect: The fix keeps the blue crash-screen clear color for the stepping and EmuScreen_NoFrame clears; the NoFrame clear that wiped it to black came from the later commit 8d8ff58 (PresentedThisFrame condition).
reason: This change only renamed thin3d to draw in those lines; the overwriting clear was introduced afterwards.

defect: The change guards memcpy with Memory::IsValidAddress(u32(data_)), treating a host pointer as a PSP address; the fix 'crash in debug build' only adds another such check on the heap buffer data_base.
reason: The underlying crash on an invalid dataBuf predates the change and the fix does not correct the flawed guard, so it cannot be told whether the debug crash was caused by this change.

defect: DxState3::set and restore pass p2 instead of p3 for the third render state, so stencil pass-op and stencil mask are set to the wrong values.
reason: The fix sets _state3 to p3 in the class this change added, and the copy-paste error is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix pushes indexGen.MaxIndex()*stride vertex bytes instead of vertexCount*stride and draws vertexCount indices; this change only hoisted the stride into a local and kept the same expressions.
reason: The wrong vertex-data size and draw count existed before this change.
